name: Scatter Chart
description: Dots for correlation, or bubbles sized by a third value, in coloured groups with a legend of counts.

props.name: groups
props.type: { name: string; points: { x: number; y: number; size?: number; label?: string }[]; color?: string }[]
props.description: Points in groups, one colour per group. When any point has a size, dots become bubbles sized by area.

props.name: xName
props.description: What x measures, for the tooltip, and written under the bottom axis unless xLabel is set.

props.name: yName
props.description: What y measures, for the tooltip, and written above the left axis unless yLabel is set.

props.name: sizeName
props.description: What the size measures, for the tooltip.

props.name: formatSize
props.description: Writes the size in the tooltip.

props.name: formatXAxis
props.description: Writes the tick labels along the bottom. Defaults to compact numbers.

props.name: formatYAxis
props.description: Writes the tick labels on the left. Defaults to compact numbers.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels, including the axis names.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show a legend with each group's count.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: A title under the horizontal axis. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: A title beside the vertical axis, set sideways. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated from the data, including the direction and strength of the relationship, when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change as a signed fraction, shown as a chip beside the value.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts caption, note, action, footer and every other prop of a div.
